items.text: Cassie Ventura filed her federal lawsuit against Combs on Thursday, November 16, 2023; the settlement was announced the next day, Friday. (The trial record gives only the month; the day comes from these reports, which say the suit was filed on Thursday and settled on Friday.)

sources.title: Sean 'Diddy' Combs reaches settlement with Cassie a day after she files abuse lawsuit
Hip-hop mogul Sean 'Diddy' Combs and singer Cassie settle abuse lawsuit

items.text: Federal agents searched Combs's properties in Los Angeles and Miami on Monday, March 25, 2024. (The trial record gives only the month.)
